chunks: And O my people, work according to your capacity; I am working. You will come to know who will receive a punishment that humiliates him, and who is the liar. So watch; I am watching with you.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'work according to your capacity' mean in the context of Prophet Hud's message?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this verse highlights the dynamic of *tadabbur* (reflection) as Hud invites his people to observe the tangible outcomes of their respective paths, emphasizing that divine justice is both imminent and observable. The phrase 'act according to your station' (*makānatikum*) is often interpreted to mean acting according to their capacity or rank in the trial, underscoring personal accountability before the ultimate reckoning. This serves as a precursor to the broader theme of *istiqra'* (waiting for the result) that characterizes the prophets' dialogues with their skeptical communities.
